name: Noda & Naruko's Naughty Nights
source:
2nd Shift Pharmacy Tech, Noda, thinks he's got his little perverted world all sewed up...until Nurse Naruko from first Shift appears to show him what "perverted" really means! 

She's got the goods on what Noda's been up to, and he'd better play ball...or else! But...he'd best be careful just how far things go...! 

Five nights of choices, with around 5400 words, and a new friend!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=23008]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
二班制药技术人员野田认为他已经把自己的变态小世界全部缝合起来了……直到第一班护士鸣子的出现向他展示了“变态”的真正含义！

她了解野田的所作所为，而他最好配合……否则！但是……他最好小心事情发展到什么程度……！

五晚的选择，大约5400个单词，还有一个新朋友！
